Frequently asked questions

Is this actually free?
Yes. No credit card or account. We only ask for an optional email after you see results.
How accurate are the estimates?
Pricing is sourced from official vendor pages. Recommendations use published plan features and your team size.
Do you store my data?
Audits are saved for sharing via a unique link. Email is only used to send your summary.
What is Credex?
Credex sells discounted AI credits. We mention it only when savings are significant.
Which tools are covered?
Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, Gemini, Windsurf, Figma, and Notion.
